quickBook.title: Book in 30 seconds
quickBook.lead: Choose who you need to see. We'll show the free times.

departments.title: Who do you need to see today?
departments.lead: Pick a department to see its doctors and what they look after.

doctors.title: Specialists for the mouth, the eyes and the whole family
doctors.lead: Qualifications as printed on our board. Photos and registration numbers are being added.

visit.title: Your visit, step by step
visit.lead: The same simple flow for every department.
visit.note: Reminders and follow-up messages are sent by the clinic's booking system, ClinicFlow247.

steps.title: Book a time
steps.text: Choose a department or doctor, pick a free slot and confirm with the code sent to your phone.

steps.title: Get your token
steps.text: Tell reception your name. You receive a token number and join the queue for your doctor.

steps.title: See the doctor
steps.text: The doctor calls you in, examines you and explains what they find before anything is done.

steps.title: Take home a clear plan
steps.text: A printed or digital prescription and the next steps, including any review date.

steps.title: Hear from us afterwards
steps.text: A short thank-you and a reminder when your review or next visit is due.

messages.title: Your visit, followed up on WhatsApp
messages.lead: Nothing to install and nothing to remember. Four short messages carry the clinic's name and are only about your appointment, never your medical details.
messages.note: Example messages. The exact wording comes from the clinic's approved WhatsApp templates, and reminder times are set by the clinic. You can ask the desk to stop messages at any time.

steps.title: Booking confirmed
steps.text: Hello Lakshmi, your appointment at Dent Plus with Dr. G. Phani Krishna is confirmed for Saturday at 11:15 AM. Need another time? Use the link to change or cancel.

steps.title: Reminder
steps.text: A quick reminder: Dr. G. Phani Krishna will see you at Dent Plus today at 11:15 AM. Ashok Nagar 3rd Lane, opposite the Siti Cable office.

steps.when: A couple of hours after the visit
steps.title: Thank you
steps.text: Thank you for coming to Dent Plus today, Lakshmi. If anything your doctor explained is unclear, call or message us and we will help.

steps.title: How did it go?
steps.text: How was your visit to Dent Plus? A few honest words help other families in Guntur choose their clinic.

items.title: Explained before it is done
items.text: Options, visits and costs are discussed with you first. You decide.

items.title: The household under one roof
items.text: A parent's denture, a child's fever and a grandparent's eye check can share one trip.

items.title: Honest about limits
items.text: When something needs a hospital or a surgical centre, we say so and tell you where.
